rationale: Zone 1 reach set to 80% of protected line impedance for standard underreach. Zone 2 reach set to cover protected line plus 55% of the shortest remote backup line. Zone 3 reach set to cover protected line plus 120% of the longest remote backup line, which is well below the load encroachment limit. Time delays selected as instantaneous for Zone 1, and mid-range values for Zones 2 and 3 to ensure coordination.
